title: libDIS - IEEE 1278 Protocol Engine
summary: In-house C++ library implementing the IEEE 1278 Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) protocol for low-latency networked simulation.
highlights: Full PDU serialization/deserialization (Entity State, Fire, Detonation, Collision, Radio Communications).
Dead reckoning algorithms (position, velocity, dead-reckoning extrapolation) for smooth cross-network entity movement.
Serves as the mission-critical networking backbone connecting aircraft, tank, and joint command simulators.
